findings.summary: AdoptModal ignores the onSuccess prop; Gallery's submitted state and auto-close never trigger
findings.detail: Gallery.jsx line 66 passes onSuccess={() => { setSubmitted(true); setModalOpen(false) }} to AdoptModal. AdoptModal destructures only { pet, onClose } — onSuccess is not in scope and is never called. After a successful application POST the modal shows its internal success message but stays open, and the PetCard button never switches to 'Applied for X!' state. Fix: add onSuccess to AdoptModal's prop destructure and call onSuccess?.() after setStatus('success') in handleSubmit.

findings.summary: server/.env with real JWT_SECRET and admin password is not excluded from git
findings.detail: The root .gitignore does not contain server/.env or any .env pattern. server/.env contains JWT_SECRET=pawsync_jwt_secret_2024 and ADMIN_PASSWORD=pawsync2024. Any git push will commit these credentials to the remote. Fix: add 'server/.env' (or '**/.env') to .gitignore.
